recipe.visualDefinition: A high-drama sports victory scene featuring a central figure draped in a national flag, captured with high-contrast, grainy 1980s film photography. The composition uses a dark, atmospheric background to make the red and white of the flag and the subject's skin tones pop, topped with bold, condensed sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's upward gaze creates a diagonal tension with the top-left title.
The flag's stripes provide rhythmic movement across the center-left.
Dark negative space at the top and sides anchors the bright central action.
Red accents in the gloves and flag unify the color palette.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close shot of a muscular figure from the waist up, filling the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white and red stripes of the flag draped over the subject's shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title in the top left, moves down to the subject's face, follows the flag's curve, and ends at the supporting figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/shadowed space at the top and right margins to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep shadows and dark blues in the background and flag stars.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white in the flag stripes and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red in the boxing gloves and flag stripes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a desaturated, dark background; high value contrast between the white elements and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Minimal letter spacing for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title features a thin red outline to separate white glyphs from the background.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy condensed display face paired with a wide-tracked, light-weight secondary face for a 'cinematic credit' look.
graphicDevices: Small stars used as spacers in the top metadata line.

preserve: Condensed nature of the main title
Wide tracking of the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and aggressive feel of the main title.
Provides a similar industrial, bold sans-serif structure.
Captures the precise, clean geometry of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast 1980s film-style photo of a muscular boxer in red gloves, looking upward in triumph, draped in a large American flag. The lighting should be dramatic with deep shadows and bright highlights on the skin and flag. The background is a dark, out-of-focus arena.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, extra-condensed sans-serif title in the top left with a thin red outline. Add a single line of widely-spaced uppercase metadata across the very top edge, using small stars as separators.

verificationChecks: Is the main title extra-condensed and bold?
Is the film grain visible and authentic to the 80s era?
Does the red outline on the title provide enough contrast?
Is the top line of text widely tracked with star separators?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the red outline on the title
Amount of tracking in the top metadata line
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on gloves or clothing

avoid: Modern thin sans-serifs for the title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the flag texture looks like fabric, not a digital overlay.
Check that the red outline on the text is thin and precise.
Verify the 'star' spacers are small and centered between words.
Confirm the subject's expression conveys triumph/emotion.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast 80s sports photography with heavy condensed white-on-red-outline typography and wide-tracked header text.
